elements_selected.content: Implement edit document operations in ar-edit-core/src/edit.rs per ADR-001 event-sourced design: create (empty edit with ops:[], head:-1), add_shot (append AddShot op), move_shot (append MoveShot op with from/to positions), remove_shot (append RemoveShot op preserving full shot data for undo), trim_shot (append TrimShot op with old/new range). All ops append to log and update snapshot. Implements REQ-011 through REQ-015.
